evidence.title: OenoBench: A Wine-Domain Benchmark for Knowledge-Grounded Evaluation of Large Language Models

summary: A new benchmark called OenoBench has been introduced to assess how well large language models can understand and reason about wine-related information. The dataset offers a suite of tasks—including classification, recommendation, and factual Q&A—to provide knowledge‑grounded evaluation of LLM performance in the specialized wine domain.
title: Researchers Release OenoBench, a Wine-Domain Benchmark for Knowledge‑Grounded Evaluation of Large Language Models
